name: Where the Veil Wanes: a Blackwood Rift closes only after the 10 second Closing the Blackwood Rift channel
contract: Review item #78: on live, closing a Blackwood Rift (gameobject 2300660, quest 175048 objective 2, -2300660 x3) is the client spell 365373 'Closing the Blackwood Rift', a 10 s channel at the rift; only a finished channel counts, being attacked breaks it, and the rift then vanishes until its 60 s respawn. The PR's rift was a plain goober that credited on the click. The case joins world phase 1 beside rift 9920640 and uses the world spawn. The two Horned Ones guarding it are killed first so no attack breaks the channel.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the rifts are spawned
Clear Horned One 1 of 2 by the rift
Clear Horned One 2 of 2 by the rift
the character channels at the rift
the click alone does not close the rift
the finished channel closes one rift
